summary: Full backend + frontend testing of SababaKids MVP. 12/12 pytest backend tests pass (root/health, /places/search with all filters: category/setting/price/ages/radius/lat-lng, /events). Frontend loads and all critical flows work: header 'SababaKids' + location label, filter bar, activity grid (8 cards near Tel Aviv), city search updates results and label to 'Jerusalem' (4 cards), category filter (zoo -> 1 card), activity detail drawer with Waze/Google Maps buttons, favorite save persists (fav count=1, Saved tab shows 1), Leaflet map tab renders, Events tab renders (uses testid event-item-card-*, not event-card-*), dark mode toggle switches html.className to 'dark'.

issues: Radix Dialog missing aria-describedby / Description - accessibility console warning

action_items: (Optional/minor) Add DialogDescription or aria-describedby to ActivityDetail drawer to silence Radix accessibility warning.
(Doc-only) Event cards use data-testid=event-item-card-{id}; the review request referenced event-card - update either code or docs for consistency.
critical_code_review_comments: logger is used in geocode()/google_places() before it is defined (logger = logging.getLogger(__name__) is at bottom of file). At import time this works only because those coroutines run later, but the logging.basicConfig is also at the bottom - move logging setup near the top of server.py.
@app.on_event('shutdown') is deprecated in FastAPI - migrate to lifespan handler.
MongoDB write in search_places (db.searches.insert_one) is wrapped in a broad try/except that swallows exceptions - fine, but consider logging failures.
google_places builds photo URL that embeds GOOGLE_KEY in a client-facing URL - acceptable for Places API but note key exposure.
seed_data_creation: None - curated ACTIVITIES/EVENTS in mock_data.py used as fallback (GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY intentionally empty).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend fully green. Frontend flows validated end-to-end via Playwright: search by city/latlng, category/age/setting/price/radius filters, detail drawer, favorites (localStorage), map (Leaflet), events, dark theme toggle. Google is disabled so google_enabled=false and only curated dataset returned.
